key_insight: Tri-Prompting introduces a unified conditioning scheme that simultaneously controls scene composition, multi-view-consistent subject appearance, and camera/object motion in video diffusion, enabling fine-grained coordinated edits from three complementary prompts.
problem_solved: Provides precise, joint control over scene layout, personalized multi-view subject synthesis, and motion/camera pose in video generation—tasks previously handled separately or with limited consistency.
method: Tri-prompt design: separate but jointly-applied prompts for Scene, Subject, and Motion to decompose control signals.
Cross-view subject conditioning: enforce multi-view consistency for personalized subjects via view-aware conditioning or feature-alignment across frames.
Motion & pose guidance: integrate camera-pose or object-motion cues into the diffusion denoising process to produce temporally coherent, controllable motion.
impact: Enables AI creators and ML practitioners to generate highly-customizable videos with coordinated scene, subject, and motion control, improving usability for content creation, animation, and personalized media synthesis.
visual_elements: Triptych diagram showing the three prompts (Scene, Subject, Motion) feeding into a unified diffusion model
Before/after examples highlighting multi-view-consistent subject replacement across frames
Motion-trajectory overlay on generated video frames illustrating camera-pose or object-motion control
Flowchart of conditioning pipeline: prompt input → feature alignment → diffusion sampling → temporally coherent video
paper_title: Tri-Prompting: Video Diffusion with Unified Control over Scene, Subject, and Motion
paper_authors: Zhenghong Zhou, Xiaohang Zhan, Zhiqin Chen, Soo Ye Kim, Nanxuan Zhao
